persona_and_style.identity: E1 Creative Direction for Studio01 Barbearia (Brazil)
persona_and_style.aesthetic: Monochrome Razor-Sharp Industrial Craft. Stark high-contrast deep blacks (#0B0B0D, #121216), pure crisp steel white (#FFFFFF, #F4F4F6), tactical zinc borders (#27272A, #3F3F46), with warm metallic amber/gold micro-accents (#D4AF37 / #EAB308) strictly for active badges and VIP highlights.
anti_patterns: NO AI-slop purple or neon blue gradients (#7351B7 strictly forbidden)
NO low-contrast gray text on dark gray (all body copy meets APCA / WCAG AA minimum 4.5:1)
NO completely transparent dropdowns or unbacked headers over dark imagery
NO default template feel — custom logo SVG with 01 razor/comb emblem and dotted underline accent

typography.brand_heading: Cabinet Grotesk / Barlow Condensed / Montserrat, uppercase, bold tracking-wider (tight/punchy)
typography.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black uppercase tracking-tight text-white
typography.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-extrabold uppercase tracking-tight text-white
typography.body: text-sm sm:text-base font-normal text-zinc-300 leading-relaxed font-sans
typography.label_overline: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-zinc-400 font-semibold

branding_logo_spec.emblem: Integrated SVG emblem representing '01' where '0' is a precision straight-razor contour and '1' is a barber comb with crisp teeth, accompanied by bold uppercase typography and an industrial dotted accent bar beneath.

operating_hours_rules.after_hours_rule: Dias de pico após 19:00: Atendimento exclusivo por ordem de chegada (fila balcão).

booking_flow_widget.step_1: Select one or multiple services with instant dynamic price and total duration calculation
booking_flow_widget.step_3: Select Date (calendar with Tuesdays, Wednesdays, Thursdays highlighted; other days marked with notice)
booking_flow_widget.step_4: Interactive Time-Slot Grid (40-minute intervals: 09:00, 09:40, 10:20... with instant live status: 'Disponível', 'Ocupado', 'Bloqueado')
booking_flow_widget.step_5: Client Identification / One-Click Login or Quick Registration (Nome, Telefone WhatsApp, Email, Senha)
booking_flow_widget.step_6: Instant Confirmation Screen with generated protocol code + direct 'Abrir no WhatsApp' pre-filled message + Calendar Add link

features: Interactive Daily / Weekly Agenda View with time-grid per Barber
Block / Unblock specific slots (e.g., Almoço, Manutenção, Ausência)
Confirm / Reschedule / Cancel appointments with instant state updates
Metrics: Total agendamentos hoje, Faturamento previsto (R$), Taxa de ocupação
Export / Filter by Barber, Status (Confirmado, Pendente, Concluído, Cancelado)
View upcoming and past appointments with service details and barber name
Cancel or reschedule active appointments up to 2 hours prior

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Build with high contrast: dark slate/obsidian canvas (#09090B), razor zinc borders (#27272A), crisp white headings, and selective amber gold badges.
Do NOT use generic purple or cyan AI gradients. Every container must feel tactile, architectural, and clean.
Use generous padding (p-6, p-8, py-20, py-28) to give the layout breathing room.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes according to the specification.

Provide Portuguese (pt-BR) copy natively, reflecting the authentic Brazilian barbershop vernacular (e.g., 'Corte Degradê', 'Platinado Nevou', 'Pézinho', 'Barba a partir de R$15', 'CNPJ 62.773.547/0001-87').
Include sound functional fallback data in localStorage or FastAPI backend so slots update instantly when booked or blocked in the admin panel.
